tabs.summary: One row per tree measured in a 10x10 m plot on a transect. 'Trees' counts rows. DBH means DBH 1 (first stem); DBH 2/3 are extra stems. Native/alien comes from the Species key (sp_native_alien); the team's own codes (UKS<number>, Fern) are not in the key and show blank. Size class is Small (under 10 cm DBH 1), Medium (10 to 30 cm) or Large (over 30 cm).
One row per plot: trees counted and Cestrum (the invasive) counted. Cestrum share is Cestrum divided by trees, in per cent, so use it by transect or plot rather than averaging rows.
One row per species and height class of seedlings counted in a plot. Seedlings is the total of Count.
